def api_course_assignments(request, course_id):
    token = request.headers.get("X-API-Key", "")
    key = get_object_or_404(APIKey, token=token, is_active=True)
    key.last_used_at = timezone.now()
    key.save(update_fields=["last_used_at"])
    course = get_object_or_404(Course, pk=course_id)

metadata.proof: SOURCE: The X-API-Key header is looked up by token AND is_active=True on the APIKey model. An ex-employee or suspended instructor with a valid API key retains full access until their key is manually deactivated.
